title: Portuguese Most Likely to Post Travel Selfies — Survey
paragraphs: For a lot of people, sharing photos is an important part of going on vacation.
And according to a survey by travel company Opodo of 9,000 people across seven countries, no one is more likely to post selfies and personal photos to social media than the Portuguese.
Half of survey participants from Portugal said they share travel selfies on social media — more than people from any other country.
Next, 40% of Spanish people said they share travel selfies, as do 35% of Italians.
The only countries in the survey were Portugal, the US, the UK, Spain, Italy, Germany and France, however.
The survey also asked if travelers would post pictures that made a trip look good even if it didn't meet their expectations.
Again, Portuguese travelers were the most likely to do this, with 54% saying they would — as would 46% of Americans.
Germans were the least likely to say they'd post a positive picture of a bad trip, with just 23% saying they would.

American travelers were the most likely to say they choose travel destinations after being influenced by social media, with 49% saying they do. But only 25% of British participants said social media influences their travel plans — less than people from any other country.
Finally, the survey asked whether people check social media regularly while on vacation.

American and German tourists are the most likely to do so, with 34% of each group saying they do. But Italians are the least online while on vacation, with only 20% saying they check social media regularly during a holiday.
